title: SortingHat adaptive operating-systems exercises
summary: Students receive operating-systems exercises generated from their learning history, performance, and knowledge gaps, then submit work for multi-agent evaluation and personalized feedback. The paper demonstrates the designed workflow but does not report a classroom deployment.

sources.title: SortingHat: Redefining Operating Systems Education with a Tailored Digital Teaching Assistant
sources.evidence_quote: generates customized exercises tailored to individual students' learning histories

assessment.summary: Complete personalized operating-systems exercises selected for current needs and academic level.
student_actions: Interact with a digital teaching assistant.
Solve generated conceptual or practical OS exercises.
Submit work for evaluation and use personalized feedback to improve.

student_role.description: LLM agents generate tasks, grade submissions, and provide feedback using student history and RAG resources.

grading.method: A RAG-enhanced multi-agent workflow evaluates 20 goals and produces a score, reasons, and feedback.
